meta.name: test-driven-development
meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写实现代码,让每次改动都有测试兜底
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果担心改坏别处代码,想先立好测试再动手写实现
copy.tagline_en: Write failing tests first, then make them pass before shipping
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want tests guarding every change before you write code

howto.what: Claude 在写任何功能或修 bug 前，先写一个会失败的测试并运行确认它真的失败，再写刚好能通过的最少代码，最后清理重构。若先写了实现代码，会删掉重来。
howto.when: 当你要实现新功能、修 bug 或重构时，在写实现代码之前接管。一次性原型、生成代码、配置文件属例外，需先征得你同意。

say.text: 帮我实现这个新功能，先写测试
say.note: 它会先写失败测试，再写最少实现代码

say.text: 修这个 bug 之前，先写个能复现它的失败测试
say.note: 测试先失败，再改代码让它通过

say.text: 给这段现有代码补上测试
say.note: 先补测试，再改动现有代码

howto.what_en: Before writing any feature or bugfix, Claude writes one failing test first, runs it to confirm it fails, then writes the minimal code to pass, then refactors. Code written before its test is deleted and redone.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement a new feature, fix a bug, or refactor, before implementation code is written. Throwaway prototypes, generated code, and config files need your approval to skip.

say_en.text: Implement this new feature, test first
say_en.note: It writes a failing test, then minimal code

say_en.text: Write a failing test reproducing this bug before fixing it
say_en.note: Test fails first, then the fix

say_en.text: Add tests to this existing code
say_en.note: Tests come before changing existing code
